arms.A: frozen selected BC policy, online execution only
arms.B: BC initialized symmetric SAC + continuous expert BC regularization
arms.C: same B + fixed anchor Normal KL weight .1

common.replay: uniform 50% train expert transitions + 50% online transitions
common.robot_and_environment_inputs: same 39 channels for Actor and Critic
common.randomization: existing Level2: angle0-5deg, XYZ +/-1cm; actuator/reward/reset unchanged
common.gradient_noise_seed: separate from common collecting action-noise seed

validation.selection: best checkpoint on validation only; final retained separately
validation.frozen_baseline: initial and final evaluation, intermediate checkpoints saved without invented measurements

heldout.identical_policy_reuse: If all actor tensors and normalizers match, reuse already measured result with explicit audit
heldout.stochastic_check: C final only, 64 episodes; ongoing training stochastic successes recorded in all arms

scope: No LWD/DIVL/QAM/quality selection; selected-model retest does not reclassify original five-BC-seed gate
